Kavaliro is seeking a Network Engineer to support a client onsite in Sanford, Florida.

Pay: $43-48 per hour

Job Duties:
  • Design, engineer, and coordinate the integration of network protocols, network switches, and network, voice, wireless, security, and SolarWinds.
  • Perform daily configuration, troubleshooting, maintenance, and monitoring of network, voice, wireless, and firewall technologies.
  • Serve as a project manager on Information Technology projects, ensuring resources are used effectively to support customer needs. 
  • Provide technical and professional support, guidance, and training to other Information Technology teams.
  • Maintain a proactive role in understanding and evaluating emerging technologies and matching them with client needs.
  • Serve as a liaison on special projects, including assisting other agencies (elected officials, municipalities, etc.) with equipment configuration, installation, and interoperability.
  • Perform ongoing system and process monitoring to realize efficiencies and improve architectural design, planning, and implementation.
  • Effectively prioritize and manage multiple incidents and requests as assigned. Answer, evaluate, and prioritize incoming telephone, work order, e-mail, and in-person requests from users experiencing technology-related issues.
  • Provide authorized network access privileges to the appropriate staff.

The Financial Benefits Consultant supports all aspects of financial analysis related to clients’ group benefit programs. The Financial Benefits Analyst works closely and collaboratively with other members of the financial support team to provide support to Account Manager(s) and Benefits Consultant(s). Deliverables will include benefit and financial illustrations that allows clients to properly evaluate their benefit plans.

Pay: $100,000-120,000 annually Essential Duties and Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):  
  • Drafts and reviews accurate exhibits for quarterly and annual client meetings
  • May assist the Benefit Consultant with carrier negotiation process
  • Mentors junior team members
  • Drafts and reviews client utilization reports using various carrier reporting methods
  • Analyzes data and identifies opportunities for plan design and product changes, based upon observed utilization patterns
  • Drafts and reviews monthly reporting deliverables for clients.
  • Drafts and reviews cost projections for benefit plan offerings.
  • Analyzes industry benchmarks and drafts information for the client to show their competitiveness in the industry.
  • Develops and maintains strong working relationships with carrier partners
  • Maintains accurate, current, organized, and complete market information in internal databases

Kavaliro is seeking a Banker to support a client onsite in Brea, California.

Job Description:

Our client is seeking a Banker for a direct hire opportunity.   The Banker will be responsible for help set up small business accounts

Pay Rate: $20.00 - $28.60 per hour 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Effectively interviews and profiles customers to recommend appropriate banking products and services
  • Actively takes advantage of all sales opportunities, cross-selling bank products, and services to new and existing customers, ensuring recommended products meet the customer's needs, and referring clients to appropriate staff and/or partner(s) as needed
  • Generates new business to assist in meeting bank profitability and branch goals
  • Effectively partners with other business lines within the Bank to identify sales opportunities and provide an outstanding customer experience
  • Open and support consumer and business checking, savings, CDs, IRAs, and Trust & Estate Accounts
  • Maintains thorough knowledge of bank products and services
  • Maintains knowledge and stays abreast of applicable New Account laws, procedures, proper account titling, and required documentation
  • Ensures all documentation is approved and uploaded in the core system

We are seeking an innovative Agentic AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy autonomous AI systems that can reason, plan, execute tasks, and collaborate with users and enterprise applications. This role will focus on building AI agents powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), integrating them with business systems, and creating intelligent workflows that drive operational efficiency and business value.

The ideal candidate has experience with AI/ML technologies, modern software development practices, cloud platforms, and agent frameworks such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar technologies.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and develop autonomous AI agents that perform multi-step reasoning and task execution.
  • Build AI-driven workflows that integrate with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, CRM, ERP, and productivity platforms.
  • Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using structured and unstructured data sources.
  • Engineer prompt strategies, memory management, planning, and tool-use capabilities for AI agents.
  • Integrate AI agents with Microsoft 365, Azure services, Teams, SharePoint, Dynamics 365, and third-party applications.
  • Create evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance, accuracy, reliability, and business impact.

Service Desk Analyst
Kavaliro is seeking a Service Desk Analyst to support a large professional organization with day-to-day end-user technology needs. This is a hands-on Tier 1 support role ideal for someone who enjoys troubleshooting, working directly with users, and resolving technical issues in a structured enterprise environment.
What You’ll Do

  • Provide Tier 1 support via phone, email, and ticketing system

  • Troubleshoot Windows workstations, software, printers, peripherals, and connectivity issues

  • Install and configure hardware and software

  • Create, track, update, and document support tickets through resolution

  • Assist users with account access and common system issues

  • Escalate more complex problems to appropriate technical teams

  • Maintain technical documentation and knowledge-based articles

  • Provide professional, customer-focused support to users with varying levels of technical experience

    Pay: $23 - $25/hr
What We’re Looking For

  • Previous Help Desk, Service Desk, Desktop Support, or similar IT support experience

  • Strong Windows and general PC troubleshooting skills

  • Experience working with a ticketing system

Sales Representative – Healthcare Industry
Location: Billings, MT/ Miles City, MT Position Overview
The Sales Representative will be responsible for developing and maintaining referral relationships within healthcare facilities, including hospitals, physician offices, and specialty clinics. This role involves educating providers on company products and services, managing a designated territory, and ensuring excellent customer service and follow-up.

This is a performance-driven role that offers autonomy, growth potential, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in patient care delivery.
Key Responsibilities

  • Build, develop, and maintain strong relationships with healthcare professionals and referral sources

  • Present and promote company products and services to potential clients

  • Prospect and close new business within the assigned territory

  • Partner with internal teams to ensure efficient service delivery and client satisfaction

  • Track and report sales activity, goals, and market insights using CRM tools

    Pay: $40,000.00 - $45,000.00/annually
Qualifications

  • Experience: 2+ years of B2B or healthcare sales preferred; recent college graduates are encouraged to apply

  • Education:

Service Delivery & Client Support

· Ensure ticket queue/backlog is continuously maintained with KPIs, trends, and metrics to show achievements within customer Service Level Agreement targets.

· Deliver world-class customer service, ensuring a high level of user satisfaction.

· Build ongoing relationships with the team and client base.

· Develop a strong understanding of internal and customer requirements and processes.

Technical Support & Troubleshooting

· Troubleshoot hardware, software, connectivity, security, and mobile device issues.

· Provide support for iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and Windows desktop operating systems.

· Perform network troubleshooting, including connectivity, VLAN, routing, and Wi-Fi performance issues.

· Experienced understanding and knowledge of networking tools including: DNS, DHCP, routing, VLANs.

· Provide printer administration support, including setup, driver deployment, queue troubleshooting, and print server coordination (as applicable).

M365 Cloud Administration & Security

· Create and manage user accounts, permissions, and access control across Windows, macOS, and M365 cloud environments.

· Administer Microsoft 365 cloud services (e.g., Entra ID/Azure AD, Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams), including user lifecycle, licensing, and configuration.

We are seeking an experienced IT Systems / Microsoft 365 Cloud Engineer to support and optimize enterprise infrastructure, cloud services, networking, and security environments. The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience in Microsoft 365 administration, Windows Server management, Azure cloud technologies, networking, automation, and cybersecurity.
Key Responsibilities Windows Server & Azure Cloud
  • Administer and support Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, Group Policy, and DNS.
  • Configure, deploy, and maintain Windows Server infrastructure.
  • Manage and support virtualized environments utilizing VMware, KVM, and Hyper-V.
  • Perform system upgrades and maintain cloud-hosted and on-premises applications.
  • Implement Azure cloud solutions using modern cloud adoption and Zero Trust security principles.
  • Drive cloud transformation initiatives, including automation, DevSecOps, and AI-enablement strategies.
  • Automate administrative and operational tasks through PowerShell, Python, or Bash scripting.
Pay: $95,000.00 - $100,000.00/annually Networking
  • Install, configure, and maintain network infrastructure and related hardware.
  • Diagnose and resolve network connectivity and performance issues.
  • Design and deploy wired and wireless network solutions.
  • Manage networking services including DNS, DHCP, routing, and VLANs.

We are seeking a highly motivated, results-driven Sales Executive to join our team and drive new business growth in the employee benefits space. The ideal candidate is a proven hunter who thrives on prospecting, developing relationships, and closing new business.

This role is ideal for an ambitious sales professional with experience selling employee benefits, insurance, or related solutions who is energized by winning new accounts and building a strong book of business.
Key Responsibilities
  • Develop and execute a strategic sales plan to identify, pursue, and close new business opportunities.
  • Prospect aggressively through cold calling, networking, referrals, email outreach, and other business development strategies.
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified prospects.
  • Develop relationships with business owners, executives, HR leaders, and other key decision-makers.
  • Conduct needs assessments and present tailored employee benefits solutions that address client objectives.
  • Manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and initial contact through presentation, negotiation, and close.
  • Generate new revenue while consistently achieving or exceeding sales goals.
  • Stay current on employee benefits trends, market conditions, and competitive offerings.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure a smooth transition from prospect to client.

Resource Coordinator Schedule: 7:30 AM–4:30 PM
Location: Onsite
Position Overview The Resource Coordinator will support a workforce of 60+ employees by managing recruiting, onboarding, employee relations, and workforce coordination. This role works closely with the customer and internal teams to ensure staffing needs are met, employees are properly supported, and workforce retention remains a priority.
The ideal candidate has experience in Human Resources and Recruiting, strong communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Key Responsibilities
  • Manage recruiting, hiring, onboarding, and employee assignments.
  • Coordinate staffing needs, workforce planning, and scheduling with the customer.
  • Address employee relations matters, including disciplinary actions and terminations.
  • Ensure employees complete required training and receive necessary equipment, IT tools, and uniforms.
  • Maintain accurate employee assignments and records in Salesforce.
  • Coordinate with payroll and billing teams to ensure accurate and timely employee payments.
  • Monitor performance evaluations and communicate appropriate follow-up actions.
  • Immediately escalate safety concerns and HR issues to management.
  • Develop and implement policies and procedures as needed.
